attchmntText: Steelcast Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Steelcast Limited has made the audio recording of its earnings conference call for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 available on its website. The call was held on 13th November 2026. This filing is pursuant to regulation 46 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The audio file can be accessed at the URL https://www.steelcast.net/pdf/investor/10049346.MP3. The company secretary, Umesh V Bhatt, submitted this intimation to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The stock code on BSE is 513517. The stock symbol on NSE is STEELCAS.

attchmntText: Steelcast Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Steelcast Limited has fixed 20.11.2026 as the record date for the payment of the second interim dividend for the financial year 2026-27. This decision was taken by the Board of Directors during their meeting held on 13th November, 2026. The company is notifying the BSE and NSE of this record date.

attchmntText: Steelcast Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 0.45 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Steelcast Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company declared a Second Interim Dividend for FY 2026-27 at Rs. 0.45 per equity share, payable on or before 13th December, 2026, with a record date of 20.11.2026. The Board approved an additional investment of Rs. 31 Crores in a Greenfield Foundry for capacity addition of 3250 Tons. This brings the total approved capacity addition to 11750 Tons and total investment to Rs. 151 Crores. The new capacity is to be added within 2 years by 31/03/2028. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, net sales were Rs. 26,284.09 Lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 4,741.17 Lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 4.68.

attchmntText: Steelcast Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Steelcast Limited submitted an investor presentation for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, to the BSE and NSE. Q2FY27 revenue grew 29% year-on-year to Rs. 138.0 crore, with EBITDA increasing 12% to Rs. 33.8 crore. Half-year revenue rose 23% to Rs. 262.8 crore, and EBITDA increased 14% to Rs. 65.8 crore. The company remains debt-free with free reserves of approximately Rs. 120 crore. The Board approved an additional 3,250 TPA capacity expansion, bringing total planned capacity addition to 11,750 TPA with an investment of approximately Rs. 151 crore. New renewable energy plants are under commissioning by 31st December, 2026. The company expects over 30% growth in FY27 and maintains an order book of Rs. 145 crore.
